scope: Official train and validation only; both new selectors change only final submission among pre-existing checked, public-matching SQL; no extra inference or tool calls. Validation was scored using untouched official score_document against all three instances with full trace replay.

cross_schema_retrieval.method: 382 train questions and corresponding reference SQLs. Question vector uses IDF-weighted 1-3-grams with rare words anonymized; retrieve top-k questions outside the current database. Compare candidate SQL AST operator multisets, projection types and arities with neighbors via weighted mean multiset Jaccard. Select k, similarity threshold and replacement margin on leave-database-out fit records; tie break least losses, changes, stricter threshold/margin. k=7, margin>0.10, similarity>=0.0.
cross_schema_retrieval.train_pool_incumbent: Choose best V8 score, keep public-matching draft unless challenger scores >0.12 higher; missing public matches contribute zero to both. The candidate source differs from full V8 inference.

hint_votes.method: Count the four cached repair_hint draws by alias-normalized SQL. Among distinct public-matching checked candidates, switch from an incumbent public match only if the unique most-voted group reaches the threshold and outvotes the incumbent. Alias normalization removes select-alias names and resolves unambiguous table aliases within each SELECT. 2 and 3 votes are separate probes. Changed submissions can differ only in notation. All hints come from the same fixed public model.
hint_votes.historical_training: 4 previously logged V5 rollouts/question; episodes of a question are correlated. No scores/labels used by the selector.
